SELECT 
    c_name,
    c_custkey,
    o_orderkey,
    o_orderdate,
    o_totalprice,
    SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_quantity,
    YEAR(DATE_ADD(o_orderdate, INTERVAL 5 YEAR)) - YEAR(o_orderdate) AS COL_ALIAS,
    NULL AS col7,
    NULL AS col8,
    NULL AS col9,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tpch_customer.c_phone LIKE '%20-797-136-2398%' THEN lineitem.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    CAST('1362' AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS COL_ALIAS_1,  -- Explicit DECIMAL cast
    LPAD(c_name, 6, ' ') AS LPADCOL  -- Added pad string
FROM tpch_customer, orders, lineitem
WHERE o_orderkey IN (
    SELECT l_orderkey
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_orderkey
    HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 300
)
AND c_custkey = o_custkey
AND o_orderkey = l_orderkey
AND MONTH(STR_TO_DATE('12/06/2004', '%m/%d/%Y')) = MONTH(l_commitdate)  -- MDY format
AND (YEAR(STR_TO_DATE('03/12/2022', '%m/%d/%Y')) - YEAR(l_receiptdate)) < 2  -- MDY format
GROUP BY c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    w.warehouse_name,
    ST_Y(CAST(hc.cust_geo_location AS POINT)) AS GETYCOL,  -- Cast to POINT
    ho.order_total,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS col4,  -- Explicit type cast
    CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS col5,  -- DECIMAL to match first part
    CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS col6,  -- DECIMAL to match sum_quantity
    0 AS col7,  -- Integer for year diff
    hc.cust_email,
    hc.cust_first_name,
    hc.cust_last_name,
    hc.customer_id,
    l.location_id,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS lpad_placeholder  -- CHAR cast for string column
FROM h_customers hc
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
CROSS JOIN warehouses w

SELECT 
    hc.cust_first_name AS first_name,
    w.warehouse_name AS nearest_warehouse,
    TO_NUMBER(sdo_util.to_wktgeometry(hc.cust_geo_location).GET_WKT()) AS GETXCOL,
    ABS(w.location_id) AS COL_ALIAS,
    LENGTH(l.postal_code) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS col_alias_1,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS col_alias_2,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS col_alias_3
FROM h_customers hc
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
CROSS JOIN warehouses w
LEFT JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE ho.order_total > 10000 
  AND NOT l.country_id LIKE '%US%' 
  AND NOT hc.cust_last_name LIKE '%Pacino%'
UNION ALL

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS first_name,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS nearest_warehouse,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id) AS COL_ALIAS,
    0.0,
    0.0,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)),
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)),
    CAST(NULL AS NUMBER)
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN building_type = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' ELSE building_type END AS type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(parent_building_number, fclt_building_key)) AS buildings,
        COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id) AS mit_id_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT building_street_address) AS address_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS city_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS state_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT postal_code) AS postal_code_count,
        SUM(ext_gross_area) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id), 0) AS avg_area
    FROM fclt_building_hist floor
    JOIN fac_building_address ON floor.fclt_building_key = fac_building_address.building_key
    JOIN buildings ON buildings.building_key = fac_building_address.building_key
    JOIN fac_rooms fr ON fr.building_key = buildings.building_key
    JOIN employee_directory e ON e.office_location = fr.fac_room_key
    WHERE fac_building_address.address_purpose = 'STREET'
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN building_type = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' ELSE building_type END
) 
UNION ALL

WITH filteredlists AS (
    SELECT 
        ml.moira_list_name, 
        mlo.owner, 
        COUNT(mld.moira_list_member) AS total_member_count 
    FROM moira_list ml 
    JOIN moira_list_detail mld ON ml.moira_list_key = mld.moira_list_key 
    JOIN moira_list_owner mlo ON mld.moira_list_owner_key = mlo.moira_list_owner_key 
    WHERE UPPER(ml.moira_list_name) LIKE 'E%' 
    GROUP BY ml.moira_list_name, mlo.owner 
    HAVING COUNT(mld.moira_list_member) BETWEEN 10 AND 20
), 
csstudentcounts AS (
    SELECT 
        ml.moira_list_name, 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN msd.department = '6' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS cs_student_count 
    FROM filteredlists fl 
    JOIN moira_list ml ON fl.moira_list_name = ml.moira_list_name 
    JOIN moira_list_detail mld ON ml.moira_list_key = mld.moira_list_key 
    JOIN se_person se ON UPPER(mld.moira_list_member) = UPPER(se.krb_name) 
    JOIN mit_student_directory msd ON se.full_name = msd.full_name 
    GROUP BY ml.moira_list_name
)
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM lineitem.l_shipdate) AS YEARCOL,
    CASE 
        WHEN lineitem.l_returnflag LIKE '%N%' THEN lineitem.l_discount 
        ELSE part.p_size 
    END AS IFCOL,
    TO_CHAR(lineitem.l_receiptdate, 'Mon DD, YYYY') AS COL_ALIAS,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM lineitem.l_commitdate) AS DAYCOL,
    part.p_partkey & lineitem.l_linenumber AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    TO_CHAR(lineitem.l_receiptdate) AS COL_ALIAS_1
FROM lineitem
JOIN part ON part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey
WHERE 
    (
        part.p_brand = 'Brand#12' 
        AND part.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') 
        AND lineitem.l_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 11 
        AND part.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5 
        AND lineitem.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') 
        AND lineitem.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
    ) OR (
        part.p_brand = 'Brand#23' 
        AND part.p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK') 
        AND lineitem.l_quantity BETWEEN 10 AND 20 
        AND part.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10 
        AND lineitem.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') 
        AND lineitem.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
    ) OR (
        part.p_brand = 'Brand#34' 
        AND part.p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG') 
        AND lineitem.l_quantity BETWEEN 20 AND 30 
        AND part.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15 
        AND lineitem.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') 
        AND lineitem.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
    )
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    fl.total_member_count,
    0.0 AS IFCOL,
    fl.moira_list_name AS COL_ALIAS,
    0 AS DAYCOL,
    0 AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    fl.owner AS COL_ALIAS_1
FROM filteredlists fl
JOIN csstudentcounts cs ON fl.moira_list_name = cs.moira_list_name
WHERE cs.cs_student_count > 0.75 * fl.total_member_count 
  AND cs.moira_list_name LIKE '%elephant-river%'

    fb.building_name,
    ff.floor,
    fo.organization_name,
    fo.hr_department_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN ff.assignable_area = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE CAST(fr.area AS DOUBLE) / ff.assignable_area 
    END AS perc_of_asg_floor,
    CASE 
        WHEN fb.assignable_area = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE CAST(fr.area AS DOUBLE) / fb.assignable_area 
    END AS perc_of_asg_building,
    fb.warehouse_load_date + INTERVAL '0 DAY' AS COL_ALIAS,
    CAST(fr.access_level AS DECIMAL(13,3)) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    TO_CHAR(fb.warehouse_load_date) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    fb.warehouse_load_date + INTERVAL '7 DAYS' AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    DATE(fr.warehouse_load_date) AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATEADD(DAY, 26, fo.warehouse_load_date)) 
        - EXTRACT(DAY FROM fo.warehouse_load_date) AS COL_ALIAS_4
FROM fac_rooms fr
JOIN fac_building fb ON fr.building_key = fb.fac_building_key
JOIN fac_floor ff ON fr.floor_key = ff.floor_key
JOIN fac_organization fo ON fr.organization_key = fo.organization_key
UNION ALL

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS room_full_name,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS building_name,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS floor,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS organization_name,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS hr_department_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t3.birth_date) AS patient_age,
    t1.client_id,
    CAST(t3.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS COL_ALIAS,  -- Truncated date → timestamp
    CAST(0.0 AS DOUBLE) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    CAST('2025-05-30 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    CAST('2025-05-30' AS DATE) AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    CAST(0.0 AS DOUBLE) AS COL_ALIAS_4
FROM disp t1
INNER JOIN card t2 ON t2.disp_id = t1.disp_id
INNER JOIN client t3 ON t1.client_id = t3.client_id
WHERE t2.type = 'gold' AND t1.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(iss.warehouse_load_date) AS COL_ALIAS,
    CAST(isd.warehouse_load_date AS CHAR) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_4,
    CASE WHEN NOT (isd.attendance LIKE '%Participants%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FALSECOL,
    isd.max_enrollment AS GETXCOL
FROM iap_subject_session iss
JOIN iap_subject_detail isd 
    ON iss.iap_subject_session_key = isd.iap_subject_session_key
JOIN buildings b 
    ON b.building_number <> iss.session_location
WHERE isd.attendance LIKE '%Participants%'
    AND REGEXP_LIKE(iss.session_location, 'ZOOM', 'i')

UNION ALL

    w.warehouse_name,
    hc.cust_email,
    hc.cust_first_name,
    hc.cust_last_name,

FROM h_customers hc
INNER JOIN h_orders ho 
    ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
CROSS JOIN warehouses w
INNER JOIN locations l 
    ON w.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE ho.order_total > 5000 
    AND l.country_id = 'US'

SELECT
  p_brand,
  p_type,
  p_size,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt,
  AVG(partsupp.ps_partkey) AS COL_ALIAS,
  COALESCE(p_type, p_brand) AS NVLCOL,
  CASE WHEN p_type LIKE CONCAT(p_brand, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS STARTSWITHCOL,
  (SUM(partsupp.ps_partkey * part.p_retailprice) - (SUM(partsupp.ps_partkey) * SUM(part.p_retailprice) / COUNT(*)) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
  ((COUNT(*) * SUM(part.p_retailprice * partsupp.ps_availqty) - SUM(part.p_retailprice) * SUM(partsupp.ps_availqty)) / NULLIF((COUNT(*) * SUM(partsupp.ps_availqty * partsupp.ps_availqty) - SUM(partsupp.ps_availqty) * SUM(partsupp.ps_availqty)), 0)) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
  ((COUNT(*) * SUM(part.p_partkey * partsupp.ps_suppkey) - SUM(part.p_partkey) * SUM(partsupp.ps_suppkey)) / (COUNT(*) * COUNT(*))) AS COL_ALIAS_2
FROM
  partsupp,
  part
WHERE
  p_partkey = ps_partkey
  AND p_brand <> 'Brand#45'
  AND p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
  AND p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
  AND ps_suppkey NOT IN (
    SELECT s_suppkey
    FROM supplier
    WHERE s_comment LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
  )
GROUP BY
  p_brand,
  p_type,
  p_size;
